Row1 idle neutral fan relaxed in hand; small inhale shoulders up; exhale with robe/ribbon slight movement; eyes closed blink. Row2 walk left boot forward; passing stride; right boot forward; opposite passing stride, alternating legs and arms, not static translation. Row3 fan tucked WINDUP; OPEN fan forward; FAN THROW empty open casting hand extended (no fan held); CATCH fan back to hand. Row4 palms CHARGE fan folded in other hand; one open palm RELEASE forward; broad fan SWEEP left across body; broad fan SWEEP right away from body. Row5 LOTUS OPEN arms relaxed apart with fan held; LOTUS HOLD palms composed fan folded; defensive GUARD with fan; CHANNEL fan upright at chest. Row6 SPIN front-facing torso twist fan extended; SPIN back-shoulder twist fan trailing; STORM RAISE fan high above shoulder; STORM RELEASE fan extended forward. Row7 hurt recoil eyes open; hurt deeper eyes shut; dying KNEEL; prone DEAD resting on side with complete robe, ribbons and fan. All poses retain same details and physical scale; hands anatomy clean. No drawn energy or wind. Body only.
